status: Secondary post hoc author-model verification after negative primary results. No model or parameter selection using holdout scores.
model: SupplementarySoftwareFile/Co-Culture_Model; define_parameters.m uses opt_params.mat x, not p_var; fixed params from p_fix_struct; active bJAG235 line in main.m gives 1.58369475/60 per minute
initialization: get_init_cond.m assumption: zero internal state integrated 100000 min under published ambient L0; actual initial internal states unmeasured; measured fraction only initializes logit fraction
inputs: Recorded LightInput[k], left held over interval k; hours converted to minutes; setpoint not used by model
holdouts: All eight original frozen trajectories; no exclusions
metrics: Run macro RMSE, full, (0,40h], >40h. Free-run baseline initial composition; one-step baseline persistence. Exclude initial observation. Internal states are not corrected from observations.
integrator: BDF rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-10; rtol/atol tenfold smaller for all-eight numerical sensitivity; nonnegative extension only for fractional-power trial operands, accepted state minimum checked.
references: Archived OL_Simulation_0L.mat and OL_Simulation_800L.mat numerical references from their exact saved initial state; do not classify as measured biology.
fitting: None. No optimization or data-tuned correction. No new biological or controller validation claim.
